newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-W.Australia low could become cyclone - bureau.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-W.Australia low could become cyclone - bureau.

text.p: A tropical low off the Western Australian coast had the potential to develop into a category one cyclone in the next 24 hours, the Bureau of Meteorology said.
Category one is the weakest cyclone on a scale of one to five.
Gales with gusts of up to 90 km an hour may develop on the coast between Port Hedland and Exmouth on Saturday, it said.
Strong thundersqualls were likely in coastal areas on Friday, it said.
The bureau issued a warning for coastal communities between Port Hedland and Exmouth.
The tropical low was estimated to be 280 km northnorthwest of Karratha and 350 km north of Onslow on Friday morning and moving southeast at five km an hour toward the coast, it said.
The low has resulted in offshore oil installations shutting in production as a precaution.
